metadata.name: Capitol Mall
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A scaled-down look-alike of the National Mall: 300 m of lawn, gravel walks and elm rows from a domed capitol at the east end to a columned memorial with its great seated statue at the west, past a 44 m obelisk you can climb inside to a sniper deck, and a reflecting pool lined with cherry blossom. Fight through the capitol's rotunda and chambers, the natural-history museum (a mammoth in the rotunda, a theropod in the fossil hall) and the air-and-space museum, where the flyers on show can be taken out through the glass front. The Capitol team holds the east end, the Memorial team the west.
